generations.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / ui-mockup.
Edit the attached full-screen Chinese fantasy roguelite three-choice reward UI. This is a focused revision of the existing design, not a new layout.
KEEP: Exactly three equal-sized vertical cards, their existing illustrations, names, all Chinese copy and statistics, the forest backdrop, title, bottom refresh button, same readable ivory typography, same dark green panels, same card positions and large illustration proportions. Left remains 普通 / 长刃; middle remains 稀有 / 霜径; right remains 史诗 / 乘隙斩. Maintain the reference's premium realistic enchanted-forest game art.
CHANGE 1 — Rarity needs to be instantly obvious, not merely a 1-pixel outline:
LEFT COMMON: sculpted brushed ivory-silver edging, modest neutral charcoal/silver header plate, no jewel and no aura.
MIDDLE RARE: substantial clearly visible saturated sapphire-blue enamel border rails, about 12–16 pixels wide at this resolution, with narrow silver outer trim; a deep blue dimensional HEADER PLATE across the top 65% of the card width, bold white label 稀有, ONE prominent faceted blue diamond centered above it. The four corners have broad sapphire insets with small silver botanical relief. Delicate concentrated blue light only along inner edge, not a foggy neon tube. The blue must be visible even in a thumbnail.
RIGHT EPIC: equally substantial violet-amethyst enamel border rails with double layered contour and subtly more elaborate curved corner silhouettes, an amethyst HEADER PLATE with bold white 史诗, a recognizably THREE-STONE amethyst crest, large central stone and two small side stones. Antique pale gold metal edging. Restrained violet glow concentrated at gems. Distinct in both silhouette and color from rare. Do NOT make every tier primarily gold. Preserve equal content area.
CHANGE 2 — lower text panels feel empty:
Add clearly visible yet low-contrast embossed botanical decoration to the dark green lower halves: elegant mirrored fern and oak-leaf sprays hugging left/right margins, a faint circular leaf-vein heraldic watermark in the lower EMPTY SPACE beneath body copy, and a fine engraved leafy divider above each select button. Use aged olive/bronze tones at roughly 10–15% contrast, soft low-relief shading, no bright gold filled flowers. Decorations should be present at normal size without forming a dense wallpaper. Keep center behind every text line dark and calm, no ornament crosses the numerals or words. Place the small botanical seal in the common card's large unused gap beneath "扩大近战打击范围", not behind text. Use fewer motifs on cards with longer descriptions so spacing stays comfortable. Titles, action tags, stat text and buttons stay legible with the same positions, and keep the existing short Chinese descriptions verbatim.
Constraints: only strengthen rarity identity and add subordinate panel ornament. No new text, no new skill, no altered numbers, no fourth card, no additional currency/cost. Avoid generic gacha excess, thick shiny plastic, blazing neon halos, giant wings, ornamental overload, body-text obstruction, different card heights. All information must remain crisp and visually dominant over decoration.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Make exactly one small typography repair to this Chinese three-card game UI image. Preserve every illustration, enhanced blue/purple/silver border, gemstone crest, panel ornament, background, title, all other text, stats, buttons, proportions and positions.
The MIDDLE rare blue card "霜径" must retain its gameplay prerequisite label. In its bottom text area, below the two lines "剑气沿途留下冰霜" / "减缓敌人移动", restore a small centered blue-gray outlined pill with the exact clearly readable text "需要冰系剑气". It belongs immediately above the "选择此祝福" button. Remove or move the tiny circular leaf emblem only on this middle card as necessary to make room for this prerequisite pill; preserve the low-contrast leafy side decorations and keep them out of the text. Do not change the other two cards. Do not add any other text. This should otherwise be an exact copy of the source design.

Use case: ui-mockup / precise-object-edit. Revise the four-rarity UI design sheet in reference image 1 so all four qualities are MUCH easier to distinguish at a glance. Reference image 1 is the edit target. Reference image 2 shows the new desired styling of the common, rare and epic frames plus text-panel botanical ornament; match this new direction and extend it to legendary. Preserve exactly four equal-sized tall card frames in one row on the plain dark evergreen design board. Retain heading "林庭秘契 · 四档品质" and centered bottom "刷新选项" button. No environment background, no illustrations, no stats, no extra text. Each frame has an empty illustration window in its top 42%, an empty dark-green text area below, and a blank recessed choose button at base.
The cards are labeled left to right "普通", "稀有", "史诗", "传说", large readable ivory text on substantial colored plaques.
COMMON: brushed ivory-silver metal rails, charcoal/silver header plaque, no gem, simplest single frame silhouette, absolutely no gold glow.
RARE: prominent saturated sapphire blue enamel rails 12–16px wide, silver edge metal, broad blue header plaque, exactly ONE large diamond-shaped sapphire above it. Blue corner insets with sparse silver leaf relief. Its whole silhouette should read BLUE, not predominantly gold.
EPIC: amethyst-purple enamel rails, layered double frame with sculpted corner insets, antique pale-gold outline, broader violet header plaque and THREE-STONE crest, big amethyst flanked by two smaller amethysts. Distinct purple material and angular layered silhouette, restrained local purple light.
LEGENDARY: substantial amber-orange and antique GOLD sculpted rails, elegantly chamfered extra outer frame, full symmetrical gilded oak-and-laurel CROWN at top with a large honey amber center gem and small orange side inlays, rich amber-gold header plaque, warmer luminous inner edge and a few tiny bright flecks immediately close to the metal only. Its crown silhouette and gold/orange color should read most prestigious from far away; do not use giant wings or a blazing halo.
All four have SAME clean interior area and matching baseline. Let crests rise slightly above their matching top border. Don't fill all rims with gold.
LOWER TEXT AREA ORNAMENT: In the bottom half, mirrored flowing fern/oak leaf botanical sprays hug the left and right margins, and a small understated circular leaf emblem plus thin engraved botanical divider rests above each button. The motifs use muted olive-bronze embossing at about 10–15% contrast. Clear and intentional but visually below any future text. The middle text area must stay dark and calm with plenty of space; no dense wallpaper or bright gold illustrations behind text. Use the second image as the exact visual reference for the ornament strength and placement. Decorative low-relief material texture may be present. Upper art windows stay calm and empty.
Premium mature realistic forest fantasy UI design, tangible enamel and carved metal, crisp readable Chinese, strong rarity color coverage and DIFFERENT CREST SHAPES as well as color. No checkerboard transparency, no watermark.
